connector.name: Youtube Video Analyzer
connector.registryDescription: MCP stdio server for analyzing YouTube videos with Google Gemini
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package youtube-video-analyzer-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ludmila-omlopes account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
